title: Move Checklist Task Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=move:checklist
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(phase) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many move checklist task events land each day and how many distinct move phase values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest move checklist task records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct move phase values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much move checklist task activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
